title: How to Write a Sales Role Play Script: Template and Example
summary: Write a sales roleplay script that scripts the buyer: hidden facts, branching responses, pass evidence, plus a copyable template and cold-call example.
body_markdown:
If the rep...


The buyer...


Opens with small talk or "Do you have 30 seconds?"


Says "What's this about?" and stays guarded


States a clear reason for calling and asks how reps prepare


Shares the surface facts


Asks whether that covers everyone


Reveals hidden fact 1


Asks what makes full coverage hard


Reveals hidden fact 2


Pitches before either hidden fact is out


Says "Sounds interesting. Can you send me something?"


Accepts "send me something"


Says "Great, thanks," and ends the call


Proposes a specific short meeting tied to what the buyer said


Checks the calendar and accepts one time


Asks for an email for the invite


Says "Text me at this number and I'll reply with the email I want you to use."
